title: You've been drinking more

title: Talk of marriage
body: You and Polina have been together for 2 years. Polina brings up marriage. Polina has almost no savings and no debts.

title: A risky offer
body: Money is tight, and life shows no sign of getting better. Someone you know offers you risky work: "Help me out just once, and there's big money in it for you."

title: Buy a car on installments?
body: It costs about $20K (in US terms). With $1,379 saved right now, you can't pay for it all at once. If you buy it on installments over 4 years, you will carry the debt until then, with interest.

title: Choose a new job
body: You used to work as a street vendor / small trader. Education: high school. These are the jobs you can find in the countryside in Russia.

title: Vera is seriously ill
body: Vera, 0 years old, has had a fever for days that won't come down. A big hospital would cost about $124 out of pocket (in US terms). You have $5,754 saved.

title: A class reunion
body: Word came of a class reunion, the first in a long time.

title: Learn to cook?
body: Most days you just grab whatever is to hand.
